description: Searches Messages (iMessage, SMS, RCS). With text or dates: finds messages across all history, newest first, optionally only with a person. With neither: lists recent conversations, optionally only those with a person or group name, each with its id for messages_read.

limit.description: At most this many (default 20 conversations or 50 messages)

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

person.description: A name from Contacts, a number, an email address, or a group's name

since.description: Only messages from this time on (ISO 8601)

name: messages_find
title: Find Messages
